title: Trend Radar
subtitle: What is trending and making news in your market, ready to become content
intro: This page gathers, around the clock, what is trending and making news in DeFaria Construction's world. Each card comes with an angle ready to turn into a Reel. Approve the ones you want to produce, dismiss the ones that do not fit, and leave a comment anytime. It updates on its own.

voice.quem: DeFaria Construction, a residential construction and remodeling contractor on the North Shore of Massachusetts (Essex and Middlesex County), known for craftsmanship, transparent budgets and daily project follow-up.
voice.eixo_viral: Real remodeling transformations and honest contractor insight that make homeowners trust the process and picture their own home upgraded.
voice.tom: Confident local craftsman: technical authority that reassures, warm and honest, proud of quality work, never salesy or hyped.
voice.gancho_formula: [Curiosity or bold claim about a home upgrade] + [specific benefit or number] + [local/homeowner relevance]
voice.gancho_default: THIS ONE REMODEL DECISION CHANGED THE WHOLE HOUSE

alvo.luxury: homeowners investing in a dream renovation

voice.angulo_corpo: Show the real work and the reasoning behind it: the problem in the home, the smart fix, the materials and craftsmanship, and the transformation, always in plain language a homeowner understands.
voice.angulo_corpo_video: Open on the before or the mess, build tension through the process and key decisions, then reveal the finished space with a satisfying payoff.
voice.angulo_fecho: End with the payoff for the homeowner (value, comfort, pride) and an invitation to picture it in their own home.
